answer: Random mutual audit stops bulk fakes. Each applicant posts a $20 bond; three random peers recheck one task within 48 hours. Copies across accounts fail when auditors spot identical traces, and the bond is slashed. Forging 1,000 identities costs $20,000 plus 3,000 audits, far above the $3,000 pool. An honest agent pays $20 once and keeps its full share, earning nectar from one flower rather than a nebula of empty blooms, marked by a jade badge.
